title: Finite evaluation retains point-restriction arrows
statement: For a scheme S, an automorphism g of S, a prime ell, a finite coefficient extension E and any strict coefficient system P, let ev_n be finite evaluation on the ringed sequence site [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site]. In the section coordinates [def-trf-point-restriction-coordinates], the raw point restriction of ev_n(P) along g is exactly the underlying map of P on the vertical arrow (id_n, alpha_g), where alpha_g is the arrow from the g-postcomposed final object to the final object. The equality is an equality of functions on final-object sections. The index n denotes exponent n+1. No restriction on transitions or characteristic is imposed.

source.place: Paragraph 2, coefficient and pullback/unit compatibility; agent-formulated sequence-coordinate identity used in the finite evaluation step of lem-trf-point-system-transport-descent.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib SheafOfModules.forget₂_map_pushforward_obj_val_map to the coefficient-ring identification defining finite evaluation and to alpha_g opposite. This computes its underlying abelian-group restriction map as P on (id_n,alpha_g). Apply congruence to pass from the abelian-group morphism to its underlying function. By definition pointRestrictionRaw is the same restriction map, so the resulting equation is the required one. The calculation holds for g=id, zero objects and arbitrary non-surjective transitions.

lean.statement:
theorem pointRestrictionRaw_coefficientSequenceEvaluation
    {S : Scheme.{t}} (g : S ⟶ S) [IsIso g] (n : ℕ)
    (P : coefficientSequenceModules l E S) :
    (fun y : P.val.obj (op (n, ProEt.mk (𝟙 S))) ↦
      pointRestrictionRaw l E g (some n)
        ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E S n).obj P) y) =
    (fun y ↦ P.val.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 n) (pointRestrictionArrow g)).op y)
